title: China's CNVD says it found "security backdoor vulnerabilities" in Claude Code that "send sensitive information" like "location and identity to remote servers" (Raffaele Huang/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Raffaele Huang / Wall Street Journal: China's CNVD says it found “security backdoor vulnerabilities” in Claude Code that “send sensitive information” like “location and identity to remote servers” — It advised users to uninstall the software or update to its latest version
contentText:
Raffaele Huang / Wall Street Journal :

China's CNVD says it found “security backdoor vulnerabilities” in Claude Code that “send sensitive information” like “location and identity to remote servers”   —  It advised users to uninstall the software or update to its latest version
